1651-4288-5921-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-4288-5921-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-4288-5921-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2034-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

687-3530-4050-4613-8130.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three additional counters of any kind on Tayam and/or additional creatures you control.
687-3530-4050-4613-8130.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Initiate, adding mana.
When Grim Initiate dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate [[Tayam]] by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, milling three cards and returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability again, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter and a -0/-1 counter from the creature token and a vigilance counter from Grim Initiate.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Grim Initiate and the creature token, adding mana.
When Grim Initiate dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three cards and returning Grim Initiate from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-3530-4050-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2459-4247-4948.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Estrid's Invocation.
Repeat.

728-1844-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least X.
728-1844-5571--6.description:
Use Fateful Handoff to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 2.

323-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

997-4640-7082--201.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

4640-5231-7082--201.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with changeling, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Repeat.

824-997-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-997-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-997-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

413-1349-5239.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
413-1349-5239.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its ability from Enduring Bondwarden and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1594-2781-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4885-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-4885-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-4146-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic
1618-2440-4146-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Murmuring Mystic triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4146-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1315-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

730-1479-2841-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
730-1479-2841-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3750-6102-7015.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Sun Warriors.
You control five or more creatures.
3750-6102-7015.description:
Declare Sun Warriors as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of creatures you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ashling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-6102-7015.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can make infinite Allies using Sun Warriors.

1445-2267-2921-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-2921-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3528-3976-5436.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3528-3976-5436.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
3528-3976-5436.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4359-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

1809-2781-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
1809-2781-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Returned Pastcaller, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

1284-4067-5242.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Lu Xun.
Lu Xun does not have summoning sickness.
1284-4067-5242.description:
Activate Lu Xun by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Lu Xun triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Lu Xun.
Repeat.

687-1429-2034-3818.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
687-1429-2034-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Lesser Masticore trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Lesser Masticore.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1082-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, triggering it and Dual Nature's first abilities.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling any other creature you control until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all tokens with the same name as the exiled creature.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
The Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, exiling the nontoken Phantom Steed.
The nontoken Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature's second ability.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
The creature(s) enter the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's first ability that many times, creating that many creature token(s) of those creature(s).
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 7, exiling the Phantom Steed token.
The Phantom Steed token leaves the battlefield, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

678-3907-4050.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to black is at least four.
678-3907-4050.description:
Cast Underworld Hermit by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Underworld Hermit enters the battlefield, creating at least six 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Underworld Hermit, adding {B}.
Underworld Hermit dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Underworld Hermit from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Squirrels, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.

2413-5299.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling itself and all other creatures you control and creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token for each creature exiled.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, it triggers itself, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return Day of the Dragons and the other exiled cards to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Note that this is a mandatory loop that will end the game in a draw unless you have a way to end it or to use it for a game-winning effect.

262-3957-4476.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-3957-4476.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Answered Prayers three times, gaining you 1 life each time and turning it into a 3/3 Angel with flying.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

864-3622-4050-4766.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding one mana of any color.
Eternal Witness dies, triggering Deathrender, putting Gravedigger from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Gravedigger enters the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gravedigger, adding one mana of any color.
Gravedigger dies, triggering Deathrender, putting Eternal Witness from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)
